en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a quiet street with trees and wooden houses along the road. A tall flagpole with a flag stands prominently, and there is another pole, likely for utilities. The text printed on the front reads 'PARTI AF KYRKMON. NJURUNDA.' and names a local publisher ('Förlag: Handl. A. Westberg, Njurunda.'). The reverse contains handwritten text in Swedish, addressing a recipient and sending greetings.
